cluster_thesis.text: Nothing fundamental changed on 09-14. TSMC August revenue +53.3% YoY, ASML's FY26 EUR 43-45B guide and AMAT's record Q3 all stand, and no hyperscaler cut capex after the Amodei pacing essay. The -6% cluster day was multiple compression from the essay plus 84% FOMC hike odds, landing hardest on high-beta test and China-exposed dep/etch. Intact, not strengthening: the China-controls tax on front-end tools remains uneven, and the pacing narrative is now a live, if unevidenced, risk to accelerator-volume-linked steps.
cluster_thesis.falsifier: Any Q3 print or call through 2026-10-31 (ASML 10-14, TSMC 10-15, TER 10-22) citing customer order push-outs or capex deferrals tied to AI pacing; TSMC September revenue (~2026-10-09) below +25% YoY; or ASML Q3 net bookings below Q2.

margin_pool.moving_toward: Foundry and advanced-packaging capacity owner (TSM/CoWoS) and leading-edge process control (KLAC) that scales with GAA layers, HBM and packaging inspection
margin_pool.moving_away_from: China-exposed broad-line deposition/etch and DUV into mature nodes (AMAT, LRCX); a hypothesis, not yet evidenced: if pacing becomes real, accelerator-volume-linked steps (test, OSAT) are hit before litho

differentiator_reads.read: Every accelerator designer (NVDA, AVGO, AMD, QCOM) runs through it, so it captures share shifts among them.

reorder_when: TSMC September revenue (~2026-10-09) below +25% YoY, or the CoWoS 190-200k wpm end-2027 path cut on the 2026-10-15 call: TSM drops below KLAC
ASML Q3 net bookings (2026-10-14) above Q2 with China below 20% of sales: ASML moves to rank 2 above KLAC and TER
Any of ASML 10-14 / TSMC 10-15 / TER 10-22 cites AI-pacing-linked order push-outs: TER falls to rank 4 below ASML
TER Q3 (2026-10-22) guides Q4 above consensus and reaffirms a rising test share: TER returns above KLAC
KLAC Q1 FY27 (2026-10-29) discloses China above 30% of revenue or guides below consensus: KLAC falls below TER
AMAT Q4 FY26 (2026-11-13) narrows the China hit below $600M, or the controls are eased: AMAT leaves the laggard slot and ASML becomes the laggard candidate
QCOM Q4 FY26 (2026-10-30) discloses booked AI-datacenter revenue of at least $500M/qtr: QCOM enters the ranking at rank 3 or better

redundant_pairs.same_bet_because: Business screen (compute flagged near-identical 1m move/ATR): both are US front-end semicap names with the same foundry/memory customers and the same China controls, but at different process steps (process control vs dep/etch) and with different China intensity (AMAT ~30%, quantified -$600-710M; KLAC relatively insulated). Near-identical price is a shared macro factor, not the same bet.
